posts.text: Speaking from the Oval Office, President Trump rejected concerns over a "new normal" in the Gulf, calling the conflict a temporary "military skirmish." He claimed U.S. forces have crippled 92% of Iran's drone production and 89% of its missile manufacturing to block a near-term nuclear breakout.
